Henderson Products, a Douglas Dynamics brand and leading manufacturer of snow and ice control equipment for municipalities across North America, is celebrating 80 years of manufacturing excellence and dependable solutions that help keep people safe and communities thriving.


Founded in Iowa in 1946, Henderson has grown from its beginnings as a manufacturer of agricultural attachments and spreading equipment into a leading provider of snow and ice control solutions. Along the way, generations of employees have helped build Henderson’s longstanding reputation as **“The Dependable Ones.”**


Henderson’s 80th anniversary celebrations continued recently at its headquarters in Manchester. Team members and their families came together at Henderson’s main manufacturing facility and Upfit and Service Center to recognize the milestone and celebrate the people who have helped shape Henderson over the past eight decades.


Henderson’s roots in Iowa run deep. Founder Ollie Henderson established Henderson Manufacturing in Cedar Rapids in 1946, and the company moved to Manchester in 1958. Henderson continues to manufacture snow and ice control equipment in Manchester today, serving municipalities across North America.


Making the anniversary celebration especially meaningful, members of the Henderson family joined the festivities, creating a connection between the company’s beginnings and the team carrying that legacy forward today. Team members also had the opportunity to bring their families into the facilities and give them a firsthand look at how Henderson equipment is manufactured, assembled and upfitted.


As Henderson celebrates its history in Manchester, the company is also investing in its future. A new logistics facility currently under construction will support Henderson’s continued growth and represents another investment in the Manchester community the company has called home for nearly seven decades.


*“As we celebrate 80 years of Henderson Products, we recognize that this milestone belongs to the employees who were instrumental in building the company and the community that has supported us throughout the journey. Having members of the Henderson family with us at the celebration makes this occasion particularly meaningful, helping connect our history to the future we are building. We are incredibly proud of our manufacturing heritage in Manchester and remain committed to investing in our employees, our community, and the future growth of the business for many years to come.”*


**— Chad Barker, President of Henderson Products**


The Manchester events are part of anniversary celebrations taking place across Henderson locations this year, recognizing the employees, families and communities that have contributed to the company’s success.
